working_masthead.title: The Eleventh Island
working_masthead.subtitle: Cape Verde, the World Cup nation whose people mostly live elsewhere
working_masthead.note: Working strings only — the Copywriter owns the final masthead, section titles and captions. Standfirst must prime, never spoil: no 15/26, no 27.9, no zero-home-based, no 5.1x in the dek.

bgm.intent: site-wide now-playing card; longing/pensive solo guitar (sodade register), never celebratory; real morna lives as inst_01/inst_03 embeds

core_claim: Cape Verde took the reigning world champions to the 111th minute because 'Cape Verde' is much bigger than Cape Verde — the team, the money and the nation itself are the diaspora made visible, and even the UN's strictest count cannot fully see it.

edt_01.label: Hook — the night in Miami, and both goals from Rotterdam
edt_01.title: Nine Minutes from History
edt_01.editorial_notes: Match timeline verbatim from det_01 (winner = Diney own goal, 111'). Vozinha is 40 (ana_caveat_08). inst_02 (FOX highlights) is the section's video AND the agreed stand-in for the missing Lopes Cabral photo — no unlicensed portrait, no AI likeness. Do not state 15/26 or any hero-payoff number here. Hard Rock aerial sct_04 available as scene-setter.

edt_02.label: The odds, reader-runnable — and why to believe them
edt_02.title: What Were the Odds?
edt_02.editorial_notes: Odds explorer (interactives.supporting rank 1, cm_01 matchOdds) lives here, seeded Argentina vs Cape Verde. ana_20 gets its own trust paragraph. Chart ana_14 labels its column 'Elo win expectancy' to keep it distinct from the model probabilities in prose.

edt_03.label: The lead: the squad IS the diaspora (hero playground)
edt_03.title: Whose Team Is This?
edt_03.editorial_notes: HERO section. edt_04.label: The federation's diaspora-recruitment machine
edt_04.title: The Machine
edt_04.editorial_notes: LinkedIn/Roberto Lopes anecdote + Bubista profile (sct_08 portrait, inline only, 508x677). The ana_11 guess widget (zero home-based players) precedes the answer paragraph — no static ana_11 chart above it, chart_placeholder deliberately null to avoid spoiling the reveal.

edt_05.label: The UN count and its structural holes
edt_05.title: The Count with Holes in It
edt_05.editorial_notes: LAYER RULE front and center (ana_caveat_01): 146,396 = floor, sum of 24 destinations, no residual; NL/US/Spain/Senegal rendered as ghosted 'not counted' markers — the scrolly map (interactives rank 2) owns ana_01, so the static chart slot takes ana_02 (growth multiples; footnote Brazil x286 as small-base artifact). Luxembourg x7.15 / 1.21% is the color beat. Strip the UN '*' from destination names (det_17).

edt_06.label: Three layers deep: how big the real nation is
edt_06.title: The Nation of 120 Percent
edt_06.editorial_notes: Guess widget (27.9 per 100, interactives rank 6) sits BEFORE the ana_04 answer paragraph. ana_05 framed as '#20 of 212 WB-covered origins' (ana_caveat_02). Three layers must stay visibly separated: UN floor / CBS 23,150 / ACS 106,084-142,570 vs State Dept ~500k / EUDiF ~120% — attributed, never blended into one chart. Brockton (det_09): curfew + nine injured reported factually and briefly; tone stays on diaspora identity. Delfshaven photo sct_05 is this section's image.

edt_07.label: Famine, ships, Sao Tome — and the music it composed
edt_07.title: Sodade — Why They Left
edt_07.editorial_notes: Emotional heart. The Sodade scrolly (interactives rank 3) owns ana_03's fading bars — no separate static chart. inst_01 (Cesaria Evora 'Sodade', verified embed) plays inside it; imagery run: Ernestina (sct_06), Mindelo (det_media_02), Pico do Fogo (det_media_03), Cesaria Evora (det_media_01 — if animated, minimal and reverential per ai_face_policy). Famine numbers exact: 45,000 dead 1941-48; Sao Nicolau 28%, Fogo 31%; 80,000 to Sao Tome 1900-1970. Layer label still applies to the ana_03 series.

edt_08.label: Remittances: the economy the diaspora carried
edt_08.title: The Money That Built the Country
edt_08.editorial_notes: Direction-of-reading is binding (det_13): the falling share = growing denominator, NOT a fading diaspora; the 2021 pandemic surge to 15.3% is the proof beat. Rank-race scrolly (interactives rank 5) owns ana_08; ana_06 takes the static 45-year chart; ana_07 is an inline callout (#18 of 160, top 11%, SSA #4). LDC graduation (det_14, second ever, Dec 2007) closes the section as the payoff of the money.

edt_09.label: The rise, quantified: Elo climb + smallest team in the top 64
edt_09.title: The Rise, Measured
edt_09.editorial_notes: Two playgrounds live here: the Elo-climb scrolly (rank 8, ana_12, peak-1702-mid-WC kicker) and find-your-country on the top-64 board (rank 9, ana_16, personal_input). ana_15 is the color chart (upset ladder; the 2015 Portugal win vs the country holding 52% of the counted diaspora is the thesis tie — keep that sentence). Elo numbers are our implementation (ana_caveat_04, already stated in edt_02). Praia photo sct_07 accompanies the qualification beat.

edt_10.label: Close: smallest ever past the first round; the full-circle street
edt_10.title: The Eleventh Island
edt_10.editorial_notes: Precision beat first (ana_17: 3rd-least-populous participant ever; Curacao 156,263 / Iceland 352,721, WB numbers per ana_caveat_10 — never repeat the stale 'second-smallest' line). Scale-gap quiz (rank 7) sits BEFORE the ana_18 answer paragraph (5.1x, 89x, 648x; NI-1982 exclusion woven per ana_caveat_06). Live status = one compact dated display-only sentence (as of 2026-07-04: eliminated; Argentina vs Egypt Jul 7). sct_03 Rotterdam-flags is the reserved full-circle image; inst_03 'Petit pays' is the closing embed. End on the open question, not a summary.

hero.why_hero: The core claim made contestable: toggle the five foreign birth countries off the 26-man squad and the reader produces the collapse — 15 players, half the caps (50.3%) and 3 of 4 World Cup goals vanish; the team that qualified stops existing. Runs on the shipped client model cm_02 (squadTally, node-verified 15/414/33 = 57.7/50.3/44.0).

supporting.earns_place: The hook's improbability, reader-derived: re-run the 3.4/8.3/88.3 night on the published model (cm_01) and re-match Cape Verde against any of the 32 knockout teams incl. never-reached Egypt — a match-odds payoff the squad-stripping hero cannot produce. Chosen over img_02/img_05 (same finding: one ana_19 playground only).

The layer-honesty thesis made visible: walk the 24-destination floor map (Portugal 52.5%, France 23.8%) into the ghosted not-counted markers for NL/US/Spain/Senegal — the reader produces 'the UN total is a floor with holes' themselves. Distinct from ana_04's ratio widget (where vs how big). Chosen over img_08 (same finding).

The one shrinking series (Sao Tome 4,250 -> 1,115, -73.8%) scrolled wave by wave while the verified 'Sodade' embed plays — the reader produces the feeling the numbers record: the community the song mourns is disappearing from the table. No other element touches ana_03.

The flattest number in the dataset lands as a correction: guess how many of the 26 play club football in Cape Verde — zero, across 14 club countries. Distinct from the hero (birthplaces vs employment): even the island-born XI professionalised abroad.

The country's whole economic history read off one rank line (#2 of 90 in 1980 -> #40 in 2010 -> #18 of 160 in 2024): the reader produces the 'dependence receded because GDP grew' insight themselves. Distinct from ana_06 (share series, static chart) — rank race vs level; img_09 cut as the duplicate remittance teach.

Guess the floor: 27.9 counted emigrants per 100 residents lands on an isotype grid, then the honest three-layer beat (floor < censuses < ~120% heritage). Distinct from img_07 (how big relative to home vs where + holes); layer label mandatory (ana_caveat_01).

The closing record made felt: guess the population gap to the next-smallest knockout nation ever, then 5.1x (Uruguay 1966) and 89x (average 2026 participant) land at dot scale. Distinct from ana_17's participant precision beat (advancers vs participants).

The 25-year climb ridden, not read: #138 of 198 (1998) to #64, with the kicker that the all-time peak (1702) was set DURING the World Cup on 2026-06-26. Distinct from ana_14 (career arc vs four-match tournament) and from the odds explorer (trajectory vs probability).

Where-you-land lever: pick your own country on the current top-64 board and produce the comparison — every team above Cape Verde has at least 3x its population (min Kosovo 1.58M). Distinct from ana_18 (current rating board vs all-time WC history); the only personal_input kept (img_18 cut: overlapping move, medium feasibility).
